alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 2 at 5:47AM CDT until October 2 at 9:00AM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected with water levels up to 1
to 2 feet above normally dry ground during high tide cycle.

* WHERE...In Louisiana, Lower St. Bernard, Southeast St.
Tammany, Eastern Orleans, Lower Plaquemines, Coastal
Jefferson, Lower Lafourche and Lower Terrebonne Parishes. In
Mississippi, Southern Hancock, Southern Harrison and Southern
Jackson Counties.

* WHEN...Through 9 AM CDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.
